analysis.session_summary: Canada's September Labour Force Survey dominated the window: Employment Change printed -68.3K against a 6.1K forecast, driving CAD 0.300% weaker and lifting USD/CAD 47.8 pips (+0.336%) to 1.426. Prelim UoM Consumer Sentiment missed at 46.3 vs 47.5 but the USD basket moved only 0.014%, inside the noise floor. AUD and GBP closed near highs while JPY's attempt was rejected after giving back 76% of an early +0.17% move. DXY rose 0.177% to 101.96 and VIX fell 2.846% to 16.91, a restrained risk backdrop.

themes.evidence: Employment Change -68.3K vs 6.1K forecast; CAD -0.300%; USD/CAD +47.8 pips (+0.336%) to 1.426.
Prelim UoM 46.3 vs 47.5 forecast; USD basket moved 0.014% inside noise; DXY +0.177%.

themes.theme: Risk sentiment steady but FX dispersion
themes.evidence: VIX -2.846% to 16.91; AUD +0.121% and GBP +0.117% lead; CAD -0.215% and NZD -0.135% lag.

currency_drivers.USD: No clear USD driver; UoM miss muted at 0.014% inside noise, DXY up 0.177%.
currency_drivers.EUR: No own releases; tracked lower -0.085%, rangebound.
currency_drivers.JPY: Attempt rejected; led +0.17% then gave back 76%, no releases.
currency_drivers.GBP: No releases; closed at its best, +0.117%.
currency_drivers.AUD: No releases; strongest at +0.121%, held range.
currency_drivers.CAD: Employment Change -68.3K vs 6.1K forecast; CAD weaker 0.300%.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD moved down 43.2 pips then retraced 19.5 pips; neither leg had a clear catalyst.

polarity_reads.read: Normal polarity: a large employment miss translated directly into CAD weakness, suggesting the market was not already positioned for such a weak print.
Muted reaction to a soft UoM miss (46.3 vs 47.5) implies the USD was already priced for weak consumer confidence and no incremental Fed information.

scenarios.name: CAD underperformance persists
scenarios.thesis: Canada's large employment miss leaves CAD vulnerable with no calendar ahead to force a reversal; USD/CAD closes near its highs and USD remains firm.
scenarios.invalidation: USD/CAD trades back below 1.420 or retraces the full 47.8 pip gain

pair_paths.rationale: Normal CAD weakness after Employment Change -68.3K vs 6.1K; USD/CAD already +47.8 pips, range 91.5 pips.
EUR/CAD +0.131% on the day; additional CAD weakness would extend the cross.

scenarios.name: Mean reversion in CAD crosses
scenarios.thesis: USD/CAD jumped 47.8 pips to 1.426 and sits mid-range; without fresh Canadian catalysts, profit-taking can pull it back toward pre-release levels.

pair_paths.rationale: Close at 1.426 after +47.8 pips, close_in_range 0.58, leaves room to fade.
EUR/CAD +0.131% can retrace if CAD stabilizes.

scenarios.name: Risk-on continuation, high-beta supported
scenarios.thesis: VIX fell 2.846% to 16.91 and Russian diesel supply headlines ease energy risks, supporting AUD/GBP and pressuring USD.
scenarios.invalidation: VIX turns higher or USD/JPY rallies above 158.333

pair_paths.rationale: AUD strength +0.121%, held range, risk-on can extend gains.
NZD lagged at -0.135% and can catch up if risk sentiment improves.

risks.risk: Headline reversal from Trump/Putin diesel deal
risks.why_it_matters: The top headline was a Russia diesel supply agreement; a reversal could hit oil and risk FX.

risks.risk: Soft UoM consumer confidence gets re-priced
risks.why_it_matters: UoM missed at 46.3 vs 47.5 and was ignored; if the market re-prices Fed easing, USD can slip.
Multiple legs had no clear catalyst and moved on flow; thin Asia can produce sharp reversals.
